review.limitations: Nonblind AI_PROXY with prior experiment familiarity, not a human rating. Two depth-correct views and two V1 finite sections can miss hidden or off-plane geometry. Per-pixel visibility does not certify topology; near-coincident surfaces can remain ambiguous. V1 Poly3D collection occlusion is superseded for 3D visibility by the depth gallery. Source style is not a unique target.
review.notes: Depth views reveal a blue rectangular/notched insert inside the tub-like shell, rather than an absent C. Its relationship to the lower or sloping gray seat remains ambiguous. Openings, irregular shell panels, and uneven seat geometry persist; V1 finite sections do not resolve useful thickness versus a separate insert. Adoption and whole-body completeness remain UNCERTAIN; the barrel style itself is not a failure criterion.
review.prior_familiarity: NONBLIND; prior related experiments and cached 85b geometry were reviewed before this task; current model/stage labels were visible; no current numerical score table was read for these judgments.
review.review_basis: Actual viewing of all 12 TRAIN depth-correct pages plus the previously reviewed V1 finite-section pages. Original V1 image_path/image_sha256/reviewed_image_sha256 are retained; depth evidence is bound by the added depth fields.
review.v1_notes: The generated object has a tub/barrel-like shell rather than the common four-leg style; that style change alone is not a failure. C and a broad lower gray surface are partly occluded, with triangular openings/folded-looking pieces in the seat region. The available views do not establish a complete functional seat, support, or a separate replacement layer.
